correctness.rationale: An exact two-stage acyclic face-poset matching is reconstructed with monotone endpoint-incidence fiber, covers all faces except the counted critical m-edge base matchings, and gives a one-vertex CW model with only dimension m-1 additional cells. Parity enumerates the critical faces for all H, e. Explicit alternating crosspolytope join cycles pair unimodularly with maximal-base-face cochains, yielding the integral primitive basis and split inclusion. The standalone checker passes all stated graph cases. No finite experiment substitutes for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural minimal two-leaf edge-endpoint defect has a sharp parity law for every finite base graph, detects use/avoidance of a prescribed edge by perfect matchings through homotopy, and gives a saturated integral inclusion image rather than just Betti ranks. Sunlet cycles show an odd/even topology transition not inferable from the fully whiskered ambient type. This supplies a structural gluing/deletion tool for matching complexes, not an arbitrary finite example.
